governing_goal: Make UAOS capable of discovering and evaluating capability gaps without waiting for incidents, while ensuring incident-, knowledge-, and opportunity-driven evolution all traverse one evidence-traced transaction from governing outcome and discovery through proposal, evaluation, governed promotion, execution evidence, and post-promotion observation. Distinguish repository-enforced controls from native-host paths that are not physically mediated.
supported_architecture_findings: AF-001-FRAGMENTED-EVOLUTION-OWNERSHIP: opportunistic.py, maintenance.py, gates.py, lifecycle.py and drill.py split timing/admission/promotion/state/orchestration without one discovery-to-observation transaction owner.
AF-002-CAPABILITY-GAP-NOT-FIRST-CLASS: pre-rebuild ChangeProposal admitted failure classes or evaluated knowledge but not newly discovered latent capability gaps.

AF-003-POLICY-EXECUTION-SEPARATION-RECURS: live direct-main mutation and inherited-progress drift occurred despite repository rules/gates because native ChatGPT tool/response paths are not verified as physically mediated.
AF-004-REPAIRABLE-STOP-RECURRENCE: confirmed repairable gaps were twice reported/recorded without continuing repair until the user demanded it.

architecture_decision.reason: The evidenced defect is transaction ownership and origin modeling in governed evolution. One canonical transaction closes this scope while preserving independently verified authority routing, continuity, domain-health and other control surfaces.

method_comparison: NIST AI RMF ongoing monitoring/periodic review -> supports non-incident-only review.
ISO/IEC 42001 continual improvement -> supports recurrent adaptation rather than one-off correction.
SEI ATAM business-driver/scenario/risk/tradeoff evaluation -> supports architecture comparison against governing outcomes rather than familiarity.

User-provided Felix Rieseberg height/breadth/depth lens -> height maps to governing outcome; breadth to outside-in multi-lens discovery; depth to raw evidence, professional methods/tools, novelty probes and external judge. Stretch targets require feasibility evidence rather than repeated model insistence.
candidate_implementation: config/EVOLUTION_POLICY.json is the candidate sole common governed-evolution policy owner.
src/uaos/evolution/transaction.py introduces one EvolutionTransaction spanning FRAMED -> DISCOVERED -> PROPOSED -> EVALUATED -> AUTHORIZED -> PROMOTED -> OBSERVED with optional ROLLED_BACK/RETIRED.
ChangeProposal.capability_gap_ids makes latent capability gaps first-class evolution origins beside failure classes and evaluated knowledge.
EvolutionDepthTrace binds governing outcome, raw evidence, professional methods/tools, external/independent judge, proactive novelty probes and feasibility-bounded stretch targets.
Evaluation must actually include declared judge evidence; promotion/rollback execution evidence remains in the transaction.
run_self_change_drill dogfoods the canonical transaction and preserves typed ProposalState plus the full eight-event transaction ledger.
COMMON_CAPABILITIES 1.7.0, SYSTEM_MAP 2.0, HOST_PROFILES 1.6, ENTRYPOINT, AGENTS and candidate CURRENT_SYSTEM 2.7.0 all point to the same evolution owner.
tests/evolution/test_transaction.py and test_policy_contract.py mechanically guard the transaction, depth evidence and authority projection.
